{{Exobiology species infobox}}

'''Amphora Plant''' is a pre-Odyssey surface organism named for its container-like silhouette, which resembles an ancient amphora.<ref name="canonn">[https://us-central1-canonn-api-236217.cloudfunctions.net/query/codex/ref Canonn Codex reference], snapshot retrieved 28 September 2026.</ref>

Look for upright, vessel-shaped growths. The organism has no separately named colour variants in the current Codex catalogue.
